text:
alana: tiny brag — pushed the midnight patch and everything stayed green. p99 latency comfortably under SLO. also, we just crossed 42,424,242 total requests 🎉 link: https://dash.redwood.example/42m-metrics
deploy-bot: release v3.1.2 -> prod ✅ canary healthy, no rollback
chris: 42,424,242... this number is begging to be on a cookie :cookie: or a tiny plaque
jess: cookie poll: chocolate chip / matcha / gluten-free. react with :one: :two: :three: results in 7 minutes
ops-bot: scheduled "cookie+confetti" 00:30-00:40 in kitchen (micro celebration)
riley: massive shoutout to infra + runtime for the batching fix — p95 improved during ramp. special kudos to @mike for the late-night deploy assist :raised_hands:
mike: i may have only hit the launch button but i'm accepting ceremonial sash nominations 😅
jess: poll results: :one: chocolate chip (9), :two: matcha (2), :three: gluten-free (1) — chocolate chip wins
tana: i'll bring tiny sashes that say "Midnight Merge Hero" and stickers. maybe a crown for the most heroic debuggers 👑
dev-bot: metric note: KV cache hit rate +3.4% after recent tweak — estimated token cost savings ~7% week-over-week :rocket:
chris: photos compulsory. bringing an instant camera for vibes. confetti? tiny handheld tubes only, promise not HR-level :confetti_ball:
alana: love it. quick reminder: no oncall page unless actual fire 🔥. celebrate, sleep, repeat. incredible team effort :heart:
riley: short poem for the thread: "we shipped at night, logs stayed polite. midnight cookies, servers bright." i'll stop now 
ops-bot: added reaction :party_parrot: to the root message
